title: cystopus montanus
intro: Cystopus montanus, commonly known as sea holly, is a type of marine plant that belongs to the family Labiatae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and protect against cell damage.
